description: This file contains functions and types related to managing launchd restart handoff processes on macOS, including resolving target configurations, checking process labels, building restart scripts, and scheduling detached restart handoffs.

methods.name: resolveGuiDomain
methods.description: Resolves the GUI domain string based on process UID or default.

methods.name: resolveLaunchAgentLabel
methods.description: Resolves the launch agent label from environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: resolveLaunchdRestartTarget
methods.description: Builds and returns the launchd restart target configuration based on environment.

methods.name: isCurrentProcessLaunchdServiceLabel
methods.description: Checks if the current process's launchd label matches a given label.

methods.name: buildLaunchdRestartScript
methods.description: Constructs the shell script for restarting launchd services based on mode.

methods.name: scheduleDetachedLaunchdRestartHandoff
methods.description: Schedules a detached process to perform launchd restart handoff, returning success status and PID.
